confidence_notes: Food anchors are based on India-wide restaurant benchmarks (CityCost, Trek.zone, BearSavings, dated Numbeo snapshots) adjusted down toward Hampi-specific budget figures from Tripbase and a hampi.in guide, which may be dated. Beer and wine prices are less certain; beer relies on one Hampi-specific figure, and wine is estimated from the beer relationship (about 2.5 times beer for a glass) because the only wine data point is ambiguous as to glass or bottle. The cocktail anchor comes from the Tripbase Hampi figure, cross-checked at about 2 times beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of the Hampi guesthouse market; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure the search returned (20 March 2026), not verified as the latest observation on the 2026-10-16 generation date, so it may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on India-wide restaurant and bar benchmarks, adjusted for a small Karnataka heritage tourist village, where Hampi-specific sources report budget meals and coffee well below city levels. Accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of budget guesthouse and mid-range resort pricing in Hampi and similar small Indian tourist towns.
